messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: NorthBridge started APAC pilot and immediately hit the per-minute throttle. They asked if we can provision a short-lived CIDR exception + bump per-route burst for /v1/chat.

elaine_acct: Renewal risk noted if pilot is blocked. They want a 7-day window, proposing burst=460 rps from their staging CIDR.

maria_cs: @ryan_net can you add these staging CIDRs: 203.0.116.0/28 and 198.51.103.64/28? They also want header match X-Project:nb-staging.

ryan_net: Can do. Plan: add ipset entries, create rate window with auto-revoke TTL=7d, and header allow. Recommend global_soft=650 to allow brief spikes.

josh_sre: Tagging SRE for quick risk review. I'll run noisy-neighbor/capacity check and set fallback to smaller model if needed. ETA 30m.

ops-checker-bot: APAC status clear. Recommend KV warm for northbridge prefix. Suggest p95 alert at 1500ms.

ryan_net: Drafted change:

```
# NorthBridge temp allowlist + rate window (auto-revoke 7d)
ipset add northbridge_203 203.0.116.0/28
ipset add northbridge_198 198.51.103.64/28
route /v1/chat burst=460 per_route_soft=460 global_soft=650 headers.allow=X-Project:nb-staging
# tag: northbridge-pilot-3678901234
```

ryan_net: Opening JIRA INF-7622, rollback/webhook set for 7d.

maria_cs: Telemetry note: they saw 350ms median in us-west but 900-1200ms p95 in ap-northeast during spikes. They asked about optional pin to ap-northeast-1 if we can show cost delta.

josh_sre: We can enable token-level pinning to ap-northeast-1. That lowers latency but increases egress/cost. I'll calculate cost delta and send to @elaine_acct.

elaine_acct: Please share cost delta before pin. Add renewal note that CS provided pilot assistance.

maria_cs: Scheduling a 30m enablement session Friday with docs + runbook to validate prompts and monitor quality under load.

ryan_net: Change queued pending SRE signoff.

josh_sre: Applied to staging; smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in 10. Alerts configured: p95 > 1600ms triggers rollback + model fallback.

ryan_net: Live. CIDRs allowed, rate window active, header match enforced. Watchlist created: northbridge-3678901234.

maria_cs: Please ping when live so I can notify customer and start the enablement session. We'll review telemetry after 24h and capture sentiment + any quality regressions.

elaine_acct: I'll prepare usage+cost summary for day 5 and follow up on renewal outreach.

maria_cs: Thanks team.
